- I kept one behaviour unchanged: a `Fails if:` with empty text on its own line, followed only by an indented continuation line, still counts as "no Fails if: line". Only the first line's text counts as present. The continuation text is judged for code.
- I treated every non-blank indented line as a continuation, including a nested bullet. A non-indented non-blank line ends the continuation.
- A KPI with code in both its behaviour and its failure text gets two `REFUSED` lines, behaviour first.
risks: Anything indented under a KPI is now judged for code. If a spec puts an indented note under a KPI, such as a link or a path in prose, it will be refused as part of that KPI. That follows the ticket's rule that continuation lines are part of the KPI.
